_note: Starting values, tuned from play — not a validated balance decision (ssot-power-scale.md §5.3's own precedent). Rung boundaries 1-9 are the real p10..p90 deciles of the (toughness*600+damage*400)/1000 score over the 719 non-blocked species in data/seed/creatures/_dump (measured 2026-09-01, seed-to-concrete T1.5) — chosen from the actual distribution specifically so no rung starts empty, per spec-threat-band.md §3's own warning about a fitted curve emptying rungs. thetaOffset is an evenly-stepped 0-40 ladder (~4.44/rung), amended into ssot-power-scale.md §5.3/§10 by T0.1 before this file could ship.
